items.statement: Equity raise of INR176 crores announced in Q2 FY25, comprising INR63 crores equity and INR113 crores warrants; INR91 crores received in September 2024, remaining INR85 crores expected by March 2026
items.quote: In Q2 FY '25, we announced a total equity raise of INR176 crores, comprising INR63 crores in equity and INR113 crores through warrants. Of this, INR91 crores has already been received in September 2024, and remaining INR85 crores is expected to come by March 2026.

items.statement: Working capital averaged 29 days in Q1 FY26 versus 30 days in FY25
items.quote: Despite our expanding scale, we maintained strict control over working capital, which averages 29 days a quarter versus 30 days in FY25.

items.statement: Net debt at consolidated level is INR950 crores as of June 30, 2025
items.quote: Sandeep Banka: Hi, Parikshit, so the debt at consol level is INR950 crores.

items.statement: Debt repayment of around INR140 crores planned for FY26
items.quote: Sandeep Banka: Around INR140 crores of repayment will be there in this financial year.

items.statement: Receivables currently around Rs 65-68 crore; new system-driven receivable control introduced in December expected to improve collections in coming quarters
items.quote: which right now we have a receivable as usual around the Rs. 65 crores around the figure are there, Rs. 65 crores to Rs. 68 crores figure. But as we have improve d the data system as recently in December only and which is getting digested in the entire our ecosystem, we are hopeful to improve our receivables also in the coming quarter

items.statement: Consolidated cash at end of Q1 FY26 was ₹1,239 million and net cash was ₹537 million after outstanding debt.
items.quote: The consolidated cash at the end of the quarter was ₹ 1,239 million, and the net cash was ₹ 537 million after considering outstanding debt.

items.statement: Debtor days reduced by 3 days to 44 days; inventory days at 149 days; creditor days reduced to 170 days from 90 days in Q4 FY25; cash conversion cycle at 113 days; company has sufficient liquidity
items.quote: Debtor turnover ratio is 44 days as compared to 47 days of last year. Inventory turnover days is 149 days as compared to 165 days of Q1 FY26. Creditor days is 170 days as compared to 90 days of Q4 FY25. As a result, cash conversion cycle is 113 days for Q1 FY25.

items.statement: Debtor days reduced significantly by 3 days and will continue to come down; inventory days trending in correct direction; creditor days reduced from 160-170 days to 90-100 days range; company has sufficient liquidity and warrants converting

So we have reduced our day's debtor Q1FY26 Earnings Webinar Transcript 6 significantly by 3 days and it will continue to come down in this quarter as well. items.statement: Trade receivables are in the range of INR8 crores
items.quote: The current trade receivables are in the range of INR8 crores.

items.statement: Promoters have consistently increased stake; C.K. Shastri's holding rose from 7 lakh to 28 lakh shares
items.quote: in fact, I have been, myself and Tikam Sujan are the two promoters in the group, and we have consistently been increasing our, I had 7 lakh shares, it's gone up to 28 lakh shares.

items.statement: Cash balance of Rs. 58 crores and receivables of Rs. 65 crores as of June; Rs. 12 crores collected, leaving Rs. 53 crores due
items.quote: We have about Rs. 58 crores as cash balance, Sumit. And we have about Rs. 65 crores of receivables as of June, of which we have collected around Rs. 12 crores. So, we have about Rs. 53 crores of receivables due, coming from my previous quarter.

items.statement: Preferential issue done last financial year; funds remain in FDs for future bidding and business development
items.quote: we did at a preferential issue in the last financial year. And still those funds are there with us as FDs.

items.statement: Promoters increased stake in subsidiary Preciso Metall to nearly 60% via rights issue participation
items.quote: In Q1 FY26, we further increased our stake in PMPL, raising our shareholding to nearly 60% through participation in its rights issues.

items.statement: Company raised ₹10.5 crore out of ₹12.8 crore warrant issue; balance pending warrant exercise
items.quote: We have issued a warrant of total ₹12.8 crores. Out of that, close to around ₹10.5 crores has been raised and remaining is still the, our warrant has to be or the fund has to come and the warrant exercise has to be done.

items.statement: Acquired 60% stake in Peaton Electricals; paperwork expected to complete in about a month; valuation estimated at INR20-30 crores for full company; 45% additional stake to be acquired for cash
items.quote: Management: Broader sense, right now it is difficult to comment, b ut yes we will be going with two or three valuation. Whichever lower valuation will be there, we will opt for the same. Paras Chheda: But what can be the range? Management: Like it will be in between like going by valuation, what we think is in between INR20 crores to INR30 crores

items.statement: Receivable days improved to 87 days as of June 30, 2025 from 90 days in previous quarter; management targeting further reduction
items.quote: Rohit Maheshwari: Sir, as on 30th June 2025, the receivable days is coming to, days are coming to 87 days. And for the last quarter, previous quarter, that is ending on March 2025, the receivable days was approximately of 90 days only.

items.statement: No fresh equity raise planned for current year; internal accruals and previous fundraising sufficient for working capital needs
items.quote: Padmaraj Pillai: No, right now -- see, right now, we're not focusing on that part of it because I think the accruals that we have, or the last fundraising that we did, and plus, I mean, the way we are trying to improve our numbers, I mean, like in terms of like reducing the receivable time, I think I would be positioned right now to do what I'm expecting this year.

But now we have phased it out. Only Phase 1, we are doing for about INR 40 crore to INR 50 crore.

items.statement: Farming area increased 50% in Q1; expected to more than double by year-end; asset-light lease model with 3-5 year leases
items.quote: And this quarter, we have increased the farm area by about 50%. And by the end of the year, our farming area is expected to more than double.

items.statement: Aquaculture capacity 1,800 tons last year; increased 50% this year; target 3,600 tons owned plus leased by year-end; export division 350 tons; revenue split 60% aquaculture, 40% export
items.quote: Our capacity is 1,800 tons in the last year. This year, we have already increased 50% of that. And by the end of the year, we'll have 3,600 tons for this owned plus leased. Our own is 1,800 tons, owned plus leased is earlier, around 600 tons that is going to 1,200 tons now.

items.statement: Targeting 60-65% CAGR top-line growth for next three years; maintaining ~20% EBITDA margin
items.quote: Yes. We are targeting for 60-65% CAGR growth in in top line for the next three years. It's a margin of about [inaudible 00:52:29] EBITDA. That is what we are projecting.

items.statement: Company took loans from related parties, primarily from the Chairman, to address legacy issues; these loans will convert into equity through the rights issue.
items.quote: Therefore, the Company has taken certain loans from related parties, that is primarily from myself, I had put in additional money, which will be converting into equity through this rights issue.

items.statement: Rights issue of Rs. 10 crore opened; Rs. 3.31 crore for working capital, Rs. 2.50 crore for future growth, Rs. 40 lakh for issue expenses. Promoter group to subscribe ~75% of issue.
items.quote: Through the rights issue, we are taking Rs. 3.31 crore to meet the working capital requirement , and Rs. 2.50 crore for future growth. About Rs. 40 lakhs are for rights issue expenses. The total amount of money that we are looking at raising through the rights issue is Rs. 10 crore.

items.statement: Nearly 90% of portfolio comprises funded central government projects ensuring strong cash flow visibility and reduced working capital risk
items.quote: Nearly 90% of our portfolio comprises funded central government projects, ensuring strong cash flow visibility and reduced working capital risk.
